reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Paris Saint-Germain FC are favoured at 75%, against 11% for Villarreal CF and 14% for the draw. Paris Saint-Germain FC carry 311 more Elo points into the match. reasons.text: The model expects 4.31 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 80%. Across their last five, Villarreal CF and Paris Saint-Germain FC have scored 2.9 and conceded 2.3 a game between them. Paris Saint-Germain FC are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Villarreal CF.

reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.
